title: Be Me Resolution Request (v1)
description: Agent-supplied task context, never authority. The runtime independently verifies workspace identity, clamps all hints to the immutable session capability, and records assumptions. Structurally incapable of representing elevation: there is no profile, authority, capability, source, or sensitivity field.

task.description: Untrusted retrieval hint. Never creates or overrides policy; never inherits user authority unless the harness integrity-binds a captured user prompt (Tier-2 task authority, ADR-016).

budget_hint_tokens.description: Hint; clamped to capability ceiling. May only narrow.

task_origin.description: Present only when the trusted harness boundary captured the user-authored prompt before model transformation and integrity-bound it. Absence means task text is a non-normative hint.

captured_by.description: Only one origin kind exists in v1. Model-supplied text can never claim it.

not.description: Structural elevation guards (defense in depth; additionalProperties:false is the primary guard).
